_meta.source: derived 2026-09-08 from zenstory-ai/drama-skills form cards (实拍 / 二维动态漫 / 国漫二次元 运动预算与身份锚点, MIT) + our own delivery notes (竖屏字幕、平台安全区)
_meta.note: 形态卡：一种交付形态默认带什么（画幅、单镜时长、字幕、每分钟镜数）、必带项、一句运动预算。defaults 只补缺省，不覆盖明写的值；运动预算句进每镜视频提示词；必带项进起草系统提示词并由 lint 静态核对。
_meta.composition_note: composition：先写主体落在画面哪一块，句末写明是原生画幅、不是另一种画幅裁出来或拉宽的（本仓库自写）。

cards.name: 竖屏短剧
must_have: 前 3 秒有钩子：一句开口的台词或一个看得见的动作节拍
每镜人脸可辨：主角在画面里认得出，远景后两镜内必须回到近景
字幕常开：平台默认静音播放，台词要能读
每镜只有一个主导动作，切镜带来景别或信息的变化
集尾停在一个未落地的选择或一条刚露出的信息上
cards.motion_budget: 每镜只做一次机位运动，人物动作幅度小于机位运动；人物走位不出竖幅中间三分之一的宽度。

english.name: Vertical short drama
english.motion_budget: One camera move per shot at most; the actor's movement stays smaller than the camera's; the actor's blocking stays within the middle third of the portrait frame's width.
must_have: A hook inside the first 3 seconds: a spoken line or a visible action beat
Faces readable in every shot; after a wide shot, return to a closer size within two shots
Subtitles always on: platforms autoplay muted
One dominant action per shot; every cut changes the size or the information
End the episode on an unresolved choice or a freshly exposed fact
english.composition: Clear space over the head and under the feet, with the person midway between the left and right edges; a native 9:16 portrait frame with no black bars, not cropped from a landscape shot.

cards.composition: 头顶和脚下都别贴着画边，人物站在左右的正中；原生 9:16 竖幅，上下不加黑条，不是从横版画面裁出来的。

cards.name: 横屏短片
must_have: 开场 5 秒内建立地点与人物：一个能看清空间关系的镜头
景别有交替：全景、中景、特写不连续三镜同一景别
运镜有动机：跟随、揭示或施压，不为炫技做长镜
至少一次声音先于画面进入（先听到再看到）
字幕可选：不烧字幕时台词要靠表演和口型能听懂
cards.motion_budget: 运镜要有动机（跟随、揭示、施压），每镜最多一次；人物可以全动作，但同镜并行的动作不超过两个。

english.name: Landscape short film
english.motion_budget: Every camera move needs a motive (follow, reveal, pressure), at most one per shot; the actor may move freely, but no more than two simultaneous actions in one shot.
must_have: Establish place and people within the first 5 seconds with a shot that shows spatial relations
Alternate sizes: never three consecutive shots at the same framing
Camera moves need a motive: follow, reveal or pressure; no long takes for show
At least once, sound enters before the picture
Subtitles optional: without burned-in subtitles, performance and lip movement must carry the lines
english.composition: Spend the width on the surroundings and on near-to-far layers, and keep people off the left and right edges; a native 16:9 landscape frame, not a portrait shot stretched wide.

cards.composition: 横向的宽度拿来交代环境和由近到远的层次，人物别贴着左右画边；原生 16:9 横幅，不是把竖版画面拉宽的。

cards.name: 竖屏动画
must_have: 前 3 秒有钩子：一句台词或一次姿势切换
每镜点名可动层：手、嘴、发梢、衣摆、一件道具里只让一层全动
角色轮廓与色块跨镜一致：填成纯黑剪影也认得出是谁
口型策略全集一致：不做、有限开合、完整口型三选一
字幕常开，画面里的拟声字与心声框要声明是画内还是后期层
cards.motion_budget: 默认限动：一镜只让承担因果的那一层全动，其余保持定帧或局部循环；不给所有图层同时加无因运动。

english.name: Vertical animation
english.motion_budget: Limited motion by default: only the layer that carries the cause moves fully in a shot, everything else holds or loops locally; never give every layer motion at once without a reason.
must_have: A hook inside the first 3 seconds: a line or a pose switch
Name the moving layer per shot: only one of hand, mouth, hair tips, hem or a prop moves fully
Silhouette and colour blocks stay consistent across shots: filled solid black, the character is still recognisable
One lip-sync policy for the whole episode: none, limited or full
Subtitles always on; on-screen sound words and thought boxes must say whether they are in-frame or a post layer
english.composition: The near cover, the character and the far background each sit on their own layer, clearly apart; clear space over the head and under the feet, with the character midway between the left and right edges; a native 9:16 portrait frame, not cropped from a landscape shot.

cards.composition: 近处的遮挡、角色、远处的背景各占一层，前后分得开；头顶和脚下都留出空，角色站在左右的正中；原生 9:16 竖幅，不是从横版画面裁出来的。

cards.name: 口播 / vlog
must_have: 前 3 秒说出这条视频要回答的问题
说话人正对或斜对镜头，视线看镜头
每镜人脸可辨，脸落在画面上三分之一
字幕常开、逐句跟读
切镜只在换话题或换景别时发生，不为节奏硬切
cards.motion_budget: 机位基本不动，全镜最多一次缓推；说话人只做手势和头部小动作，身体不离开画面中央。

english.name: Talking head / vlog
english.motion_budget: The camera essentially holds, with at most one slow push-in per shot; the speaker only gestures and makes small head movements, never leaving the centre of the frame.
must_have: State the question this video answers within the first 3 seconds
The speaker faces the camera straight on or at a slight angle, eyes on the lens
Face readable in every shot, placed in the upper third of the frame
Subtitles always on, following the speech line by line
Cut only on a change of topic or framing, never just for rhythm
english.composition: The speaker is framed from the shoulders up, the face between the upper-third line and the centre; a native 9:16 portrait frame, not cropped from a landscape shot.

cards.composition: 说话人只取肩膀以上，脸的高度在上三分之一线和画面正中之间；原生 9:16 竖幅，不是从横版画面裁出来的。

cards.name: 品牌情景
must_have: 前 3 秒出现产品，或它要解决的那个问题
产品每镜同一外观：颜色、形状、标识位置不漂
至少一镜产品特写，手持时看得见持握方式
结尾给行动指引留位置（后期文字区不压产品）
不出现任何真实品牌的标志或商标
cards.motion_budget: 产品在画面里的移动与机位运动二选一，不同时发生；人物动作只为把产品带进画面或使用它。

english.name: Brand scenario
english.motion_budget: Either the product moves in frame or the camera moves, never both at once; the actor's movement exists only to bring the product into frame or to use it.
must_have: The product, or the problem it solves, appears within the first 3 seconds
The product looks the same in every shot: colour, shape and mark position do not drift
At least one product close-up; when handheld, the grip is visible
Leave room at the end for a call to action (the post-text area must not cover the product)
No real brand logos or trademarks of any kind
english.composition: The product keeps its spot in the frame for the whole shot; neither it nor the person touches the frame edges, both staying in the middle band; a native 9:16 portrait frame, not cropped from a landscape shot.

cards.composition: 产品在画面里的位置整镜不挪，产品和人都不贴画边、待在中间一带；原生 9:16 竖幅，不是从横版画面裁出来的。
